title: Ryouko's Memory Note
statementMd:
Ryouko is an extremely forgetful girl, she could even forget something that has just happened. So in order to remember, she takes a notebook with her, called *Ryouko's Memory Note*. She writes what she sees and what she hears on the notebook, and the notebook became her memory.

Though Ryouko is forgetful, she is also born with superb analyzing abilities. However, analyzing depends greatly on gathered information, in other words, memory. So she has to shuffle through her notebook whenever she needs to analyze, which is tough work.

Ryouko's notebook consists of $*n*$ pages, numbered from 1 to $*n*$. To make life (and this problem) easier, we consider that to turn from page $*x*$ to page $*y*$, $|*x* - *y*|$ pages should be turned. During analyzing, Ryouko needs $*m*$ pieces of information, the $*i*$-th piece of information is on page $*a*_{*i*}$. Information must be read from the notebook in order, so the total number of pages that Ryouko needs to turn is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b19a52472036d57233f58883f6dcf82d27f98e8e.png).

Ryouko wants to decrease the number of pages that need to be turned. In order to achieve this, she can merge two pages of her notebook. If Ryouko merges page $*x*$ to page $*y*$, she would copy all the information on page $*x*$ to $*y* (1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$, and consequently, all elements in sequence $*a*$ that was $*x*$ would become $*y*$. Note that $*x*$ can be equal to $*y*$, in which case no changes take place.

Please tell Ryouko the minimum number of pages that she needs to turn. Note she can apply the described operation at most once before the reading. Note that the answer can exceed 32-bit integers.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m* (1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5})$.

The next line contains $*m*$ integers separated by spaces: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of pages Ryouko needs to turn.

## Note

In the first sample, the optimal solution is to merge page 4 to 3, after merging sequence $*a*$ becomes ${1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 2}$, so the number of pages Ryouko needs to turn is $|1 - 2| + |2 - 3| + |3 - 3| + |3 - 3| + |3 - 2| = 3$.

In the second sample, optimal solution is achieved by merging page 9 to 4.
statementZhMd:
凉子是一个极其健忘的女孩，她甚至会忘记刚刚发生的事情。因此，为了能够记住，她随身携带着一本名为 *凉子的记忆笔记* 的笔记本。她把所见所闻都写在笔记本上，而这本笔记本也就成了她的记忆。

虽然凉子很健忘，但她天生拥有卓越的分析能力。然而，分析在很大程度上依赖于收集到的信息，换句话说，就是记忆。因此，每当需要进行分析时，她都必须翻阅笔记本，这是一项艰苦的工作。

凉子的笔记本由 $*n*$ 页组成，编号从 1 到 $*n*$。为了简化生活（以及本题），我们认为从第 $*x*$ 页翻到第 $*y*$ 页需要翻过 $|*x* - *y*|$ 页。在分析过程中，凉子需要获取 $*m*$ 条信息，第 $*i*$ 条信息位于第 $*a*_{*i*}$ 页。信息必须按照顺序从笔记本中读取，因此凉子需要翻过的页数总和为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b19a52472036d57233f58883f6dcf82d27f98e8e.png)。

凉子希望减少需要翻过的页数。为此，她可以合并笔记本中的两页。如果凉子将第 $*x*$ 页合并到第 $*y* 页，她会把第 $*x*$ 页上的所有信息复制到第 $*y* 页（$*y* (1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$），因此，序列 $*a*$ 中所有原本为 $*x*$ 的元素都会变成 $*y*$。注意，$*x*$ 可以等于 $*y*$，此时不会发生任何变化。

请告诉凉子她至少需要翻过多少页。注意，她可以在开始阅读之前至多进行一次上述操作。答案可能超过 32 位整数的范围。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*（1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5})$。

下一行包含 $*m*$ 个由空格分隔的整数：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——凉子至少需要翻过的页数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，最优方案是将第 4 页合并到第 3 页。合并后，序列 $*a*$ 变为 ${1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 2}$，因此凉子需要翻过的页数为 $|1 - 2| + |2 - 3| + |3 - 3| + |3 - 3| + |3 - 2| = 3$。

在第二个样例中，最优方案是将第 9 页合并到第 4 页。
